_comment: Central rule file for AI code validation. Edit this to customize review behavior.

project.name: OSCQuery Hub
project.description: OSC device hub — bridges OSC instruments with Ableton Live via OSCQuery protocol

rules: Never use innerHTML or outerHTML with server-sourced or network-sourced data — use textContent or DOM APIs
Always validate host strings before making outbound HTTP/WebSocket connections (no SSRF)
Never set Access-Control-Allow-Origin to '*' on routes that modify state
Never expose stack traces or internal paths in HTTP responses
Never log or transmit private keys, tokens, or passwords
Validate all WebSocket message types and fields before acting on them
Never accept unvalidated file paths from user input for file system operations
All UDP sockets that receive data from localhost only should bind to 127.0.0.1, not 0.0.0.0
TypeScript files: camelCase for variables and functions, PascalCase for interfaces and types
Constants that are truly fixed: SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE (e.g. HTTP_PORT, MAX_SUBSCRIBERS)
OSC path constants: kebab-case or snake_case matching the OSC spec
File names: kebab-case (e.g. osc-utils.ts, diff-utils.js)
Manifest JSON files: <type>_<id>.json (e.g. tablet_01.json)
Do not add synchronous blocking I/O (readFileSync, writeFileSync) in hot request paths
New device types must be introduced via a manifest file in manifests/, not hardcoded in src/
WebSocket message handlers must validate msg.type before switching on it
HTTP routes that modify state must check input validity before writing to disk
Do not import from src/ inside scripts/ — keep validation scripts self-contained
The namespace Map must not grow unbounded — apply MAX_NAMESPACE guard on all writes
Do not add new runtime dependencies without updating package.json
Do not import from node_modules paths directly — always use the package name
Do not use require() in .ts files — use ES module import syntax
The osc, express, ws, bonjour-service packages are the only allowed runtime deps for src/
Target Node.js 20+. Do not use APIs deprecated before Node 20.
UDP OSC parsing must handle both Buffer and Uint8Array inputs from the osc library
WebSocket message payloads must stay under 65536 bytes (enforced in server config)
Do not call JSON.stringify on large objects inside setInterval callbacks
broadcastToClients() iterates all WS clients — avoid calling it more than once per event
Avoid synchronous fs operations (readFileSync/writeFileSync) in WebSocket message handlers
Do not create new RegExp objects from user-controlled strings in hot paths

patterns.message: Template literal with dynamic content assigned to innerHTML — XSS risk
patterns.fix: Use textContent or a DOM builder (createElement + textContent)
Use a safer alternative (JSON.parse, Function, dynamic import)

patterns.message: Wildcard CORS on a state-modifying route
Hardcoded fallback secret in environment variable access
patterns.fix: Remove the hardcoded default — fail loudly if the env var is missing

patterns.message: Template literal in execSync — potential command injection
patterns.fix: Use execFileSync with a fixed command array and validated arguments
